description: An alternative broad-exploration policy demonstrating that the state-machine engine is not tied to open-problem triage or full closure.

paper_scale_result_candidate.description: An exact potentially publishable theorem, counterexample, method, or negative result has evidence and a non-cosmetic consequence.

independent_result_audit_passed.description: A fresh reviewer reconstructed the result at its exact stated scope.

independent_result_audit_failed.description: A fresh reviewer identified a defect requiring renewed research.

portfolio_exhausted.description: The broad exploration allocation ended without a result worth independent maturation.

open_exploration.description: Explore a broad mathematical theme with agent-owned topic and route selection.

task.objective: Explore the declared mathematical theme broadly. Select, combine, replace, or abandon questions and methods as the evidence warrants. Prefer exact theorem-shaped advances, sharp counterexamples, useful no-go results, or reusable methods over activity volume.

independent_result_audit.description: Independently reconstruct the selected intermediate result.

task.objective: Reconstruct the frozen candidate result from declared evidence, audit its maximal natural scope and closest prior art, and return either an exact pass or an actionable mathematical defect.

paper_seed.description: A reconstructed intermediate result is ready for a separate novelty and manuscript-maturation policy.

exhausted.description: Broad exploration ended without a promoted intermediate result.
